Retrieve the Environmental Consulting Firms Register

Source: R/datasets.R
senace_consultoras_ambientales.Rd

Downloads the register of environmental consulting firms authorized by SENACE or retrieves its bundled local snapshot.

Usage

senace_consultoras_ambientales(api_key = NULL, offline = FALSE)

Arguments

api_key

A SENACE API key. If NULL, it is retrieved automatically.

offline

If TRUE, use the dataset bundled with the package instead of querying the API.

Value

A tibble.
